alex_dev: Customer reporting bursts of 502s for hosted API during an embeddings batch run. Happens ~15:23 UTC for tenant acme-inc. trace=t-8a3f21.
infra-bot: alert: edge-midfront 502 spike detected 2024-11-08T15:23:00Z -> 15:26:30Z. peak 502 rate 5.1% (baseline 0.6%). dashboard: https://obs.redwood/api/edges/midfront/overview
sam_support: got customer repro steps from their infra: they run 100 concurrent short embedding calls (40ms payloads) with SDK retry enabled. They sent curl snippet: `for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood-hosted/v1/embeddings & done`
alex_dev: I tried a smaller repro locally with wrk: `wrk -t2 -c40 -d30s -s scripts/post.lua --lat http://midfront.local/v1/embeddings` and saw intermittent 502s starting ~10s into the run.
maria_sre: looking at envoy access logs on midfront: repeated `upstream_reset_before_response_started` and `upstream_connection_failure`. Example lines: `2024-11-08T15:23:12Z envoy midfront [info] "POST /v1/embeddings" 502 - - "upstream_reset_before_response_started" route: /embeddings` and auth-proxy logs show many short-lived connections and `401` refreshes for the same tenant.
maria_sre: hypothesis — retry/coalescing behavior at midfront plus auth-tier token refresh/backpressure is causing upstream connection churn and envoy's concurrency/circuit-breakers to trip, producing 502s under tight short-request bursts. Also saw increased connection churn to dedicated auth cache (redis) around same window.
alex_dev: can we confirm if the midfront coalescing/queueing change from yesterday (reduce pending queue cap) could have made this worse? That PR tightened `max_request_coalesce` and reduced keepalive pools.
jess_ops: I rolled back the coalescing change at 15:31 UTC (reapplied previous settings: max_request_coalesce=0.25 -> 0.5, upstream_keepalive_pool=350 -> 500) and bumped envoy upstream_idle_timeout to 75s. Watching metrics now. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
infra-bot: mitigation deployed by jess_ops at 2024-11-08T15:31:05Z. config change id: cfg-20241108-midfront-rollback.
sam_support: customer just confirmed on the support call: errors dropped to near zero ~2m after rollback. They included new trace id t-8a3f21-2 that shows success.
maria_sre: action items — short term: keep rollback for 24h and monitor 502 rate + auth-cache latency. Long term: add per-tenant coalescing caps, improve auth cache backpressure (circuit-breaker + retry jitter), and add a canary for coalescing changes. I'll open an incident ticket with logs and traces.
alex_dev: noted. I'll add repro script and perf numbers to the incident ticket and propose a config matrix for per-tenant limits. :thumbsup:
